S/G1 ratio pseudobulk for a group of samples, optionally written to bigWig

Source: R/pseudobulk.R
export_pseudobulk_g1_ratio.Rd

Runs aggregate_pseudobulk_s_g1_counts() and calculate_pseudobulk_rt_g1_ratio() for one group of samples (for example the replicates of one condition). The result is returned, and a bigWig is written only when file is given.

Usage

export_pseudobulk_g1_ratio(
  genobins,
  meta_data,
  genome_granges,
  file = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

genobins

A sparse bins x cells count matrix, or a list of them (one per sample; the names, if any, are the sample ids).

meta_data

A data.frame with cell ids as row names and logical columns is_G1 and pass_qc.

genome_granges

Named GRanges with the metadata column is_mappable. Its names are the bin ids. Writing a bigWig needs chromosome lengths in its seqinfo.

file

NULL (default, nothing is written) or the path of the bigWig that receives the score column (needs the rtracklayer package).

...

Passed to aggregate_pseudobulk_s_g1_counts(), e.g. verbose.

Value

The GRanges of calculate_pseudobulk_rt_g1_ratio(), with the per-sample cell numbers in S4Vectors::metadata(x)$selected_cells; returned invisibly when file is given.
